name: Rothmund-Thomson症候群

summary.text: A rare syndrome characterized by facial rash (poikiloderma) associated with short stature due to pre- and postnatal growth delay, sparse scalp hair, sparse or absent eyelashes and/or eyebrows, juvenile cataracts, skeletal abnormalities, radial ray defects, premature aging and cancer susceptibility.
